curve25519-donna_1.3-c64_gcc13_x64_curve.notes: Tag 1.3, the 64-bit curve25519-donna-c64.c, x64 only (it needs a 128-bit integer: __attribute__((mode(TI))) does not compile for x86), built with the Makefile's -O2 and no -m32. One source file that GCC folds to two functions: curve25519_donna (5,553 instructions on MinGW, 5,540 on Linux) and the two-instruction load_limb. min_functions is 2, the measured count of the project's own functions in both artefacts, and not a number chosen to admit a build: the floor of eight is reached on MinGW only by the unnamed ___chkstk_ms (PicHash 12578432865501340970) and nine one-instruction import jump stubs (PicHash 1253497258561142223), none of which is this project, and not at all on Linux, where 4 two- and three-instruction PLT stubs take the image to 6. MinGW x64 12 kept + 50 removed = 62; Linux x64 6 kept + 6 removed = 12. Shares no PicHash of ten instructions or more with the 32-bit curve25519-donna.c build apart from ___chkstk_ms. The 32-bit file is the better reference for what the project is."

curve25519-donna_1.3_gcc13_x64_curve2551.notes: Tag 1.3, the 32-bit curve25519-donna.c, built with the Makefile's -O2. Thin: 6 to 7 of the file's 20 functions survive as separate functions (fsum, fproduct, freduce_degree, freduce_coefficients, fsquare_inner, curve25519_donna, and swap_conditional on x86), the rest being folded into curve25519_donna, which is 1,484 to 1,702 instructions. Below the corpus floor of eight, so the recipe sets min_functions to 6; on MinGW x64 the report's other 10 functions are the unnamed ___chkstk_ms and nine import thunks, and on Linux 4 PLT stubs. The 64-bit curve25519-donna-c64.c is a separate x64-only component (curve25519-donna-c64): two functions, curve25519_donna and load_limb. No code in common with ed25519-donna or Crypto++'s donna port (measured: no shared PicHash at ten instructions or more).
